sanskrit: kalpavṛkṣaśamīvṛkṣevaṭacaṃpakapippalaiḥmahāsadasisauvarṇe sarvavarṇapariṣkṛteāsīnaṃ parameśānaṃ avāṅmanasagocaramsarvavidyāvidhātāraṃ vāme gaurisamāyutamsastūyamānaṃ devādyaiḥ stotramaṅgalavācakaiḥmaheśvara prasannātmā śivajñānaṃ jighṛllayādevadeva jagannātha bhaktānāmārlināśanaḥśaivāntamārṇavāntajña jñānaraktapradarśakaḥbhaktyā ca parayāyuktaparasaṃvitsvarūpayāsādhakānaṃ hitaṃ puṇyaṃ yogināṃ mokṣasādhanamevaṃ pṛṣṭhomaheśena bhagavān parameśvaraḥvakṣye saṃkṣepamārgeṇa yathāpraśnaṃ tathepsitamśivajñānaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ bhogamokṣapradaṃ śubhamyuktaṃ śatasahasreṇa granthe sarvārthasādhakamtat tu saṃkṣepatastubhyaṃ adhunā saṃpravakṣyateūrdhvaśaivaṃ tu prathamaṃ ādiśaivaṃ dvitīyakamavāntaraṃ pañcamaṃ ca miśraṃ caiva tu ṣaṣṭhakamājñāśaivaṃ tu navamaṃ śaivabhedakramaṃ śṛṇuteṣu śreṣṭhatamaṃ śaiva mūrdhvasrotassamudbhavamsaumyaṃ ca dvividhaṃ proktaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ caiva miśrakamviparītaṃ tu vāmaṃ syāt dvayormiśraṃ tu saṅgamamvedāntārthamayaṃ jñānaṃ siddhāntaṃ paramaṃ śubhamvedasārārthadaṃ jñeyaṃ anyatvanyārthasādhanamnāmabhiḥ kāmikādistu vakṣyate kramaśaḥ śṛṇutrāṇaṃ ca kurute puṃsāṃ tena tantramiti smṛtam

sanskrit: nadyāṃ taṭāke kūpe vā śaucaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhiastramantreṇa nāsāsya dantaśuddhiṃ samācaretmalasnānaṃ purā kṛtvā mantrasnānavidhiṃ śṛṇuvāruṇaṃ taijasaṃ divyaṃ vāyavyaṃ mānasaṃ tathāvṛṣṭyā sādapyā dinyāṃ vāyavyaṃ rajasāṃ gavāmnadyāṃ vāpi taṭākāṃ vā kūpe vā tīrthavāri caśivaliṅgeti te vidyācchivapādaprasecanātkuryāddhastapramāṇena maṇḍalaṃ caturaśrakamsadyena sthāpayet tatra vāmamantreṇa śodhayetpūrveṇa dakṣiṇenaivā tathā vai cottareṇa tuṣaḍaṅgaṃ brahma japtvā tu pūrvādibhyo nyaset kramātsadyojāta mṛdābhogaṃ stīrthamadhye vinikṣipetṣoḍaśākṣarakaṃ nyastvā svanāmādyena lekhayetjale sūkṣmāśca ye doṣāḥ teṣāmuccāṭanaṃ bhavetpūrvavat sthāpyamṛtpiṇḍaṃ sarvāṅgañca vilepayetbrahmāgniṃ pitṛdevarṣitīrthāni kramaśaḥ śṛṇuāgneyaṃ paitṛkaṃ paścāt tarjanyaṅguṣṭha madhyataḥaṅgulyagre tīrthamārṣaṃ pañcadevāṃstu vinyasetsparśanaṃ pitṛtīrthena daivatīrthena mārjanamrājopacārasahitaṃ sugandhāmalakādibhiḥjalāvagahanānte tu divyastrīparisevitamaṅgairvyomavyāpinā ca tyambakākhyādimantrataḥabhiṣekaṃ śanairmūrdhni vidadhyādvaktramudrayādakṣapādasthale kṛtvā vāmapādaṃ jalepi camāṣamātra pramāṇena jalānāṃ prāśanaṃ bhavet

sanskrit: mukha hastena saṃspṛśya pādāvabhyukṣayet punaḥaṅguṣṭha tarjanyagrāhyā sparśennāsāpuṭadvayamaṅguṣṭhamadhyamāgrābhyāṃ bāhyoyugmaṃ punaspṛśetevaṃ kṛtvā tu mantrajña pratyaṅgamupasaṃspṛśetatharveṇetihāsena vaktrasaṃsparśanaṃ dvidhāmūrdhānaṃ cākṣuṣī śrotre sarvādityendra tṛptayepunarācamanaṃ cāpi tanmantrairevamācaretśivamantrābhiṣekaṃ tu pādamudrātvanantarampuruṣāṇāṃ ca sāvitrī mṛṣṭottaraśataṃ japetpañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgaiśca vyomavyāpi triyaṃbakamsandhyāṃ caivā tu sāvitrīṃ gāyatrīṃ sarvadevatāmsāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇamedbhūmau namonama iti bruvandevānṛṣīnpitṝṃścaiva vāmaghorājaśambaraiḥpitṝṇāmapitīrthena vidadhyāt tarpaṇaṃ kramātśrīrudraṃ puruṣasūktaṃ ca pañcabrahma ṣaḍaṅgakamtīrthaṃ saṃharaṇaṃ kuryāt astrapañjaramadhyagamdarbhadvayena vā darbhaistribhirvā pañcabhistu vāagraṃ vai caturaṅgulyaṃ grandhiścandrāṅgulismṛtaḥgranthibrahmādhidaivatyo rajjurviṣṇvadhidaivataḥagraṃ rudrādhidaivatyaṃ pavitrasyādhidevatāḥprakṣālyapādāvācamya bhasmasnānamathācaretapamṛtyupraśamanaṃ śivamārogyavardhanamsarvadevātmakau śuddhaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanamyathā goṣu viśeṣeṇa tadutpattividhiṃ śṛṇudīpaṃ ca sadgopādeṣu praṇamya pratipādayet

sanskrit: kamaṇḍaluḥ pañcamaṃ syāt ṣaṣṭhaṃ syāduttarīyakampavitraṃ navamaṃ caiva daśamaṃ bhasmakīrtitamtrayodaśaṃ mṛdgrahaṇaṃ vakṣyate tu pṛthak pṛthakkhādiraṃ campakaṃ caiva candanaṃ vilvameva cadvitālastasya vistāraṃ samutsedhaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulamdarpaṇodarasaṅkāśaṃ pṛṣṭhabhāga samāḥ padāḥjapamālābhuromālāṃ śiromālāṃ tathā punaḥpañcaviṃśati rudrākṣaiḥ mumukṣūṇāṃ japasmṛtaḥsaptaviṃśati bhuktyarthaṃ puṣṭyarthamaṣṭāviṃśatiḥitthaṃ tu japamālāsyā danyānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuśiromālā tu tannābhā bāhumālā ca tatsamādarśanaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ sparśanaṃ sarvasiddhidamśucirvāpya śucirvāpi rudrākṣaṃ dhārayet sadāsa rudrapadamāpnoti kiṃ punurmānuṣādayaḥdhāraṇāt svargamāpnoti punarjanma na vidyatedivyavarṣa sahasraṃ tu cakṣurunmīlitaṃ mayādhārayaṃ mriyate yastu sa yāti paramāṃgatimcaturvaktraṃ tu bindu syāt pañcavaktraṃ sadāśivaḥviṣṇuścaivāṣṭavaktraṃ tu navavaktraṃ caturmukhaḥhastakaṇṭha śikhākarṇa yajñasūtreṣu sarvadārājāvārtā vaṇigvārtā lokavārtā viśeṣataḥrudrākṣāṇāṃ sahasreṇa kalpitāṃ śivarūpiṇāmtasmāt sarvaprayatnena rudrākṣaistu sadā japetviprāṇāṃ mastakotsedhaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ vakṣasassamamdaṇḍameva vidhiṃ proktaṃ yogapaṭṭamidaṃ śṛṇu

sanskrit: vistāraṃ tryaṅgulastasyamānaṃ syādupavītavatāḍhakā pūritaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ madhyaṃ triprasthapūritamsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ athavā mṛṇmayaṃ tu vāuttarīyaṃ tathoṣṇīṣaṃ śuddhavastreṇa kārayetupavītaṃ cottarīyaṃ hṛnmantreṇaiva dhārayetāsanaṃ vasanaṃ cārghya gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpakamaṣṭāṅgasahitaṃ nityaṃ pūjayeddakṣiṇeśvaramśālyantaṃ caiva valyantaṃ pūjā trividhamucyatecaturbhiraṅgaissidhyarthaṃ pādyamevamudāhṛtamtakkolaṃ caiva kuṇḍaṃ ca candanaṃ caiva pāṭalamkuśāgraṃ jīramāpaśca yavaṃ siddhārthameva caarghyaṃ daśāṃśamityuktaṃ gandhadravyavidhiṃ śṛṇutadardhaṃ pādamātraṃ vā karpūreṇa samanvitamdhavalāruṇa kṛṣṇāni sātvikādi guṇatrayetāni sarvāṇi kathyante tāmasāni maheśvaratāmasaṃ kṛṣṇapuṣpaṃ tu pītapuṣpaṃ tu śobhanamnandyāvartaṃ ca punnāgaṃśvetārkamudaye dadetdroṇapuṣpaṃ tu madhyāhne viśeṣeṇa nivedayetjātīkena kadaṃ bāhyo niyojyāvardharātrakeapakva matipakvaṃ ca mukulīkutsitaṃ tathāsvayaṃpatita puṣpāṇi paryuṣitāni varjayetpuṣpajātiṣu sarveṣu giripuṣpaṃ viśeṣataḥprakṣālya parameśānaṃ arcayecca punaḥ punaḥapāmārgaśśamī caiva dalatācāmalīkarīevaṃ patrāṇi mukhyāni kīrtitāni viśeṣataḥ

sanskrit: patraṃ brahmapriyaṃ proktaṃ puṣpaṃ viṣṇupriyaṃ tathāsaṅgṛhet śivapūjārthaṃ patrapuṣpaphalādikamitthaṃ puṣpavidhi prokto dīpasyavidhirucyatecatustridvyaṅgulāyāmaṃ dīpajvālāviśiṣyate**(?) ca kṛtyaṃ tu tadvakṣye śṛṇuṣvekaṃ maheśvaratṛtīyaṃ dravyaśuddhiḥsyāt caturthaṃ liṅgaśodhanamuttarābhimukho maunī baddhayogāsanasthiraḥprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryāt pratyekaṃ daśamātrikamrecakaṃ pūrakaṃ caiva kumbhakaṃ ca tridhā matamcandrārkacaritaṃ yasya mṛtakaṃ sūtakāśritamdvaye ***(?) ye dvāyuṃ nāsikā maṇḍaladvayamsūtakaṃ pretakaṃ śrutvā pūjāhomaṃ na kārayettasmāt sarvaprayatnena kuru candrārkanāśanamūrdhvavaktraṃ tu jihvāgraṃ suṣuṃnādvārabandhanamkumbhakaṃ prāṇanirataṃ maunakarmanirantarammṛtakaṃ sūtakaṃ tyaktvā yāvannirṇayamucyateāvāhanāsanantasya mātrādvādaśakaṃ bhavetekamātraṃ bhavedarghyaṃ ṣaṇmātraṃ gandhadāpanamdīpadānaṃ tu ṣaṇmātraṃ baliṣṣoḍaśamātrikaḥsnānaṃ vastraṃ copavītaṃ trayaṃ dadyādyathāvidhimātrābhiraṣṭādhikyena śatena sahato japaḥdevaprītikaraṃ tena sarvaṃ sādhanamucyatepūjayet sarvakāleṣu dine rātrau na sā kriyācandrārkanāśanādeva pūjāsiddhaṃ maheśvarajānvādi pādaparyantaṃ pṛthivīsthānamucyate

sanskrit: ākārākṣaramārabhya prānte tvatkāramālikhethakārādīnibījāni kṣakārāntāni deśikaḥitthamakṣararūpeṇa dhyātvā dakṣiṇatomukhamdhyāyeddevaṃ tu manasā karapūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇubrahmamudrāṃ purā kṛtvā vahnibījena śodhayetaṅguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ īśānādīnkramānyasetkarābhyāṃ mantramudrāṃ ca mahānādaṃ tu bandhayetaṅguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsa ucyatevānaprastha yatīnāṃ ca saṃhāranyāsa ucyatenyasocaṃ vānaprasthasya pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥakārādi kṣakārāntaṃ aṅguṣṭhādi kramānyasetmūlaprakṛtikānnyastvā yathāpūrvanyaset tataḥśivamantraṃ sakṛjjaptvā vadhnīyādbrahmamudrikāmmūlabījamanusmṛtya likhitvā varṇamākṛtamvarṇamantraṃ viśeṣaṃ tu śṛṇuṣvevaṃ maheśvaracavargāntaṃ tṛtīyādi vapūrvāntaṃ samuccaranhāntaṃ kāntaṃ sakārāntaṃ kramādeva samuccaretbindunāda samāyuktaṃ varṇamantramidaṃ śubhamakāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasye ākāraṃ tu lalāṭakeukāraṃ dakṣanāsāyāṃ ūkāraṃ vāmake puṭeḷkāraṃ dakṣiṇe gaṇḍe ḹkāraṃ vāmagaṇḍakeoṅkāra mūrdhvadante tu aukāraṃ daśaneṣvadhaḥkavargaṃ dakṣiṇe haste cavargaṃ vāmahastakeṣaṣṭhau ca dakṣiṇe pārśve babhau vai vāmapārśvakerephaṃ raktapradeśe tu lakāraṃ māṃsadeśake

sanskrit: aghorasya kalāścāṣṭau vāmadeva trayodaśakalābhistu kalāśakti nyāsaṃ vakṣye kramācchṛṇujvālinīti kalāḥ pañcakramādetāḥ pravinyasetūrdhvaṃ ca mūrdhvasīśānaṃ sthānaṃ pañcasu vinyasetetāḥ pūruṣaśaktiśca caturvaktreṣu vinyasetditirghaṭā kṣayāniṣṭhā karmāyādi jvarātathāhṛdaye caiva kaṇṭhe ca skandhayugme tathaiva caurasītyaṣṭabhisthānairvakṣyate ca yathākramamkāryā vṛddhiḥ kriyādhātrī bhrāmaṇī ca tathā punaḥmeḍhre gude ca ūrvośca jānunoścaiva jaṅghayoḥsiddhi ṛddhidvitiścaiva lakṣmīmedhā tathaiva capādayoḥ karayoścaiva hastayoḥ kakṣayo nyasettadante piṇḍamantrāṇi tattatsthāneṣu vinyasetaghoraṃ hṛdayenyasya guhye vāmaṃ prakalpayethṛdayaṃ hṛdayenyasya śikhāśśirasi vinyasetnetreṣu netramantreṇa daśadigbandhanaṃ smṛtamākāśa bījavarge tu ṣaḍākṣara vivarjiteaghoraṃ pañcamaṃ proktaṃ naramekādaśaṃ bhavetdvitīyaṃ hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ caturthaṃ tu śiro bhavetnetraṃ pañcadaśaṃ proktaṃ astraṃ ṣoḍaśakaṃ tathāidamapyaṅgarakṣārthaṃ vinyase**(?)ṣaṃgakamśvetapītaṃ ca raktaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ vidyut ca kuṅkumamkapālaṃ śūlavaradaṃ paraśuṃ pāṇibhirghṛtamgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca varṇamantreṇa dāpayetpiṇḍamantraṃ japet paścāt bījānāṃ kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu

sanskrit: sarvamantrātmakaṃ mantraṃ piṇḍamantramidaṃ śubhamliṅgabhedakramaṃ vakṣye viśeṣaṃ tu yathākramamcalaliṅge sadāvāsaṃ pūjayet parameśvarammantrasaṃskārahīne tu liṅgamākṛti mātrakamtasmāt sarvaprayatnena svāmirūpaṃ sadārcayetsatyavastu svarūpaṃ tu paraṃ sādākhya tat **(?)pūrvākṛtiṃ parityajya sādākhyākṛtireva canṛttarūpaṃ sadā dhyātvā dakṣiṇālayamādikaḥnavatatvamayaṃ sthānaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ paramśubhaṃ paramanirvāṇaṃ sarvadeha sadāśivamhṛtpadmamadhye saṃsthāpya nādatantraṃ kalāmayamāsīnaṃ vā sunṛttaṃ vā dhyāyennityaṃ maheśvaraaṅguṣṭhamātramacalaṃ śuddhatatvaṃ navātmakamātmānaṃ tu sakārasyaṃ antarātmā tu bindukaḥsarvaṃ hṛdayamantreṇa pūjayitvā yathākramamaṣṭatriṃśatparaṃ nṛttaṃ nyāsakālakramaṃ śṛṇuaṣṭatriṃ* * * * * * (?)ṣṭatriṃśātmamantrakamdehaśuddhiṃ kalānyāsaṃ aṣṭatriṃśātmamantrakamātmaśuddhikramaṃ proktaṃ sthānaśuddhikramaṃ śṛṇu****(?)kṣya bahudhā loṣṭāsthyādīni varjayetvitāna dhvajasaṃyuktaṃ kadalīkramukānvitampuṣpamālā samākīrṇaṃ dīpamālā pariṣkṛtamśuddhodakena saṃpūrya sauranyāsaṃ samācaretsthale pṛṣṭhe ca saṃśodhya karayordakṣavāmayoḥpraṇavaṃ vahni saṃyuktaṃ *(?) kārāntāntamakṣaram

sanskrit: vyomapūrvaṃ visargāntaṃ sūryamantraṃ namontakamarkāya śirase nyasya bhūrbhuvasva śikhānyasetagnibījaṃ visargāntaṃ saurāstraṃ dik ca saṃyutamabindumekamuccārya polkasūryāntamuccarankuśākṣatenayūpāntaṃ arcayedraktacandanamekavaktraṃ dvibāhuṃ ca dvinetraṃ ghṛtapaṅkajamsarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamcaturvaktramaṣṭabāhuṃ dhyāyeddivasanāyakamsaptāśvarathamārūḍhaṃ prabhākaravibhākarammedhā prajñā samāyuktaṃ somādigrahasaṃyutamrāhuḥ ketuṃ kramādete grahā mṛtyuvināśanāḥśyāmavarṇo budhaprokto nīlavarṇobṛhaspatiḥkākameghanibhorāhuḥ ketu dhūmrābha ucyatesarvābharaṇasaṃpūrṇā dvibhujāśca prakīrtitāḥaṅkārakaṃ yāmyabhāge paścime tu bṛhaspatimketuṃ ca naiṛte bhāge vinyasedbudhamānileprabhāmuṣāṃ ca sandhyāṃ ca prajñāṃ caiva tu vinyasetathāṣṭhau lokapālāṃśca tattatsthāneṣu pūjayetṣaḍaṅganyāsamaṃbhasya arghyaṃ caiva pradāpayetpañcaprākāranāmāni śṛṇuṣvevaṃ maheśvaramadhyahāraṃ tṛtīyaṃ syāt madhyādi ca caturthakameteṣāmāyamānaṃ ca prākārāṇāṃ śṛṇu kramātantarhārakamekaṃ tu madhyahāraṃ dvidaṇḍikākūpasthānaṃ tṛtīyasya prākārasyadikīśituḥāgneya yāmyayormadhye vastraśālāsamīritā

sanskrit: mahāmaryādikaiśānyaṃ mahāmaṇṭapamucyateprākāramaṇṭapaṃ proktaṃ dvārapūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇusopānaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve kundendu ca samaprabhamkambugrīvaṃ varapradaṃ hastivaktramanantaramvarṇaśca daśavighnānāṃ vakṣyate tu pṛthak pṛthakdhūmraṃ svarṇaṃ bālasūryaṃ mauktikaṃ puṣparāgakamuttare ca kapāṭasya devatā viṣṇurucyatedakṣiṇe tu kapāṭasya śikhā bhṛṅgīśa devatāpaṭṭikānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ subrahmaṇyo maheśvaraḥastramantreṇa saṃprokṣya suṣiraṃ bandhayet tataḥgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca havirādadetkapāṭaṃ daṇḍamadhyasthau aṣṭaparvatadevatāḥkapāṭavāsi devāṃśca pūjayet svasvanāmabhiḥvāyumantreṇa yantrāṇāṃ calanaṃ kārayet tataḥdakṣiṇe dvāradevānāṃ gandharvāyakṣarākṣasāḥuttaradvāradevānāṃ ṣaṭkāroṃkāravyāhṛtiḥpārśve tu dakṣiṇe devo śivajyotiṣanāmakaḥdakṣiṇadvāradevānāṃ jñānadrutaguṇāya cauttaradvāradevānāṃ abhayāya guṇāya capārśve tu dakṣiṇe devīṃ vīrabhadraṃ prapūjayetdakṣiṇadvāradevānāṃ mārutodaityadānavāḥuttaradvāradevānāṃ madbhūtānalarudrakāḥdakṣiṇe pārśvadevānāṃ nīlalohitadevatādakṣiṇedvāradevānāṃ śivānandāvṛtāya cauttaradvāradevānāṃ īśānāṃ devatāpurāḥ

sanskrit: sarasvatī tu dvārāgre tadagre ca vṛṣastathānandīśaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve mahākālaṃ ca vāmakedakṣiṇadvāradevānāṃ daṇḍimuṇḍī tu śobhaneuttaradvāradevānāṃ bhrukuṭī vijayabhairavāḥjñānaśakti kriyāśaktiṃ garbhadvāre prapūjayetvāstoṣpatīti mantreṇa tvaiśānyāṃ vāstu devatāmmaṇīnāṃ vasavodevā sūcayet somadevatāḥtena śabdena mahatā rākṣasānāṃ vināśanamdaivikaṃ cārṣakaṃ caiva gāṇavaṃ mānuṣaṃ tathādīrghākāraṃ bhavelliṅgaṃ nimnonnata samudbhavamparvatāgrākṛtiṃ randhraṃ bahvagraṃ śikhayāyutamityetairllakṣaṇairyuktaṃ devikaṃ liṅgamucyatemadhyasthūlaṃ ca liṅgānāṃ nālikeraphalākṛtiḥvikaṭadvinisoya aṅgaṃ ca kuṃbhāsthaṃ ca **(?)nimnonnataṃ caiva nissargabheṣajaṃ vyākhyātavīraṃśca subhadraliṅgamamalīkṛtaṃ aśekaraṃ ca vivilavaikrāntakuśekaraṃ prabhuḥpārśvagra mūlāgra sumadhyamāgra mūrdhvāgraliṅgaṃ caturaśraliṅgammandaṃ ca kaiḍaṃcakaraṃ subhrullavilaṃvitaṃ suvarṇasuvarṇaliṅgamliṅgapīṭhaṃ sthalaṃ caiva śodhayet tu hṛdāṃbhasāliṅgasya mūrdhnā deśantu spṛśedīśānamantrataḥliṅgasya pārśvau bāhubhyāṃ aghoreṇānusaṃspṛśetpīṭhāntaṃ saṃspṛśet pādau bāhubhyāṃ sadyamantrataḥdevyaṃ svaṅgāni bhavanaṃ vakṣye talliṅgamucyatevimānaṃ sadanaṃ harmyaṃ vāso mandiramālayamvimānalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣvevaṃ maheśvara

sanskrit: tṛtīyaṃ jagatī caiva padmaṃ caiva caturthakambhinnaśca saptamaṃ proktaṃ stambhamaṣṭamameva caekādaśaṃ kapotaṃ ca dvādaśaṃ bhūtamālikāpañcadaśaṃ tu śikharaṃ sthūpyagraṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ bhavetādhāraśakti prathamādvitīyātvātu śaktikāguṇaśaktiḥ pañcamī tu ṣaṣṭhī ca sthānaśaktikāpañcadaśī tu kalyāṇī sthūpyagre tu maheśvarīitthaṃ śaktyā kṛterdhāmno lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate śṛṇusañcitaṃ prastarairyuktaṃ sthalahīnamasañcitamvimānaṃ liṅgaśaktīnāṃ nāmāni ca śṛṇu kramātkṣānti śaktiśca pralīkamāsthāpana jayātmikāpratiṣṭhāliṅgaṃ vārāhī sarvatobhadrakaṃ śubhamdhūmraśaktissamujvalyaṃ phaṇodghaṭasuliṅgakamguṇaśaktivṛttabhadraṃ phalaliṅgaṃ anīyakamśrīpratiṣṭhākhyasadanaṃ mūlasthūlaṃ tu liṅgakammantraśakti śiraccheda mukhaniṣkalaliṅgakamaṅgadāśaktirityuktaṃ sarvadaṃ niṣkanārthakamkriyāśaktiścayau bhadrā ṭaṃkaṃ liṃkaṃ svadhāmayīcandraṃ makuṭaliṅgaṃ ca śaktiśakti samāyutamvṛkitaṃ prakīrṇaliṅgaṃ ca tvayārāmerachandakamnādaśaktiśca kumbhaṃ ca bhadraliṅgarajāyinīvimānaṃ śivaliṅgasya kṣamāśaktyamalakṛtihaṃsacchandaṃ tu nilayaṃ vīraṃ vipulaliṅgakamgarakaścandanilayaṃ kroṇabhadrahasīyakampadmabhadravimānasya pāvanaṃ liṅgamucyate

sanskrit: rudraśaktiśca sadanaṃ kukkuṭaṃ māraliṅgakamrudrakāntaṃ tu sadanaṃ raviliṅgantu grāmaṇībhogacchandasya sadanaṃ cakraliṅgasya śoṣaṇīmerukūṭavimānasya bandhaliṅgāṃga śaktikamkalyāṇaśaktirityuktaṃ budbudaṃ rāśiliṅgakamcintyeśaktistu saumyākhyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ liktaliṅgakampālinīśaktirityuktaṃ maṅgalābhiyaliṅgakamjyotiśaktiminilitamatuśedhusuliṅgakamvijayaṃ pratiliṅgaṃ ca vidyāśakti samāyutamadvayaṃ yamamadhyasthaṃ liṅgaṃ tāṇḍavaśaktikamatipratiṣṭhaśaktiśca somacchandaṃ tu harmyakamnāgaṃ ca dantapārśvasthaditi kuryāsu vṛttakamsannadhīśaktiśrīvatsartamūrdhvāṅgastṛtiśaktikamvidrumāśaktirityuktaṃ prokṣyadāyāśraliṅgakamtannikāmantu hṛlliṅgaṃ mahāśaktirjjayāṃgakamvaiṇavaṃseti liṅgasya kāmāraṃ bhadraliṅgakamgāṇavāśālasadanaṃ tāmrābhaṃ varṇaliṅgakambhadraliṅgavimāstrī śivaliṅgantu kāryakampadmāvasānasadanaṃ caraliṅgādiśaktikamṣaṭkāraṃ liṅgakālī tu vidrumālayagopuraḥnavaṃdhārā suliṅgasyadādhārī lalitālayamsahasra śubhraliṅgasya kāmaśaktirviśālakammāṇikyaliṅgamityāhukṣāntīhārājavahnikamśailaliṅgasya dvitinaṃ dviśāśālāgragopuramsahasradhārāliṅgasya vākśaktirvijayālayam

sanskrit: anyarthaṃ sarvaniṣṭhāthīdaṃgajālayamāṣakamdhṛtiśaktisadacchāyā **(?) sphaṭikaliṅgakamnāgaśaktīti sadanaṃ drāviḍaṃ vardhamānakamsadanaṃ liṅgaśaktīnāṃ jīvaprāṇavyavasthitamtasmāt sarvātmamadhyasthaṃ jyotirūpaṃ naṭaṃ gurumśaṅkhakāhalavallaryaiḥ ghaṇṭāghoṣaiḥ sunūpuraḥsadanaṃ liṅgamadhyasthaṃ arcayettu naṭeśvaramliṅgamantraṃ samuccārya tanmantroddhāraṇaṃ śṛṇuliṅgamantramiti proktaṃ śaktīnāṃ sthānamucyatejagatībhūtaśaktistu kumudaṃ guṇaśaktikamadhaḥpaṭṭī tu kāmādhī mahāpaṭṭīmanonmanīstambhaṃ tu nādaśaktiśca padmaṃ bhairavaśaktikamkarṇikāmayinī śaktiḥ vabiṇyo uśoṣaṇīyakammahānāsī tadutsedhaṃ śikharaṃ navaśaktikamkarṇaṃ ca karuṇāśaktiḥ kumbhākṣīrāmanīyakamkambukānādaśaktiśca malakaṃ mantraśaktikamitthaṃ śaktyātmakaṃ dhāma proktaṃ sakalarūpakamjyotiprabhāsu madhyasthaṃ naṭaṃ dakṣiṇamadbhutamparāśaktiparaṃ nṛttaṃ vaidikaṃ dakṣiṇeśvaramprāsādaṃ dakṣiṇeśānaṃ pavitraṃ prabhumādikamsadānandamayaṃ sāmbaṃ sākṣisādāśivaṃ gurumsamaṃ samarasībhāvaṃ viśvatomukhamūrdhvakamkaṇṭhāt prabhṛtivasvaśraṃ prāsādaṃ drāvikaṃ bhavettrivargaṣṣaṇṇavatīnānāṃ nāmavakṣye maheśvarasarvato bhadraṃ caiva hasti pṛṣṭhaṃ samujvalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrībhadraṃ ca śiracchandaṃ gopuraṃ sarvadā kṛtiḥrudracchandaṃ ca lalitaṃ ityete daivikāmatāḥjayāṅgaṃ vimalāṅgaṃ ca vimalākṛtimeva capadmāṅgaṃ padmabhadraṃ ca śaryaṃ kukkuṭakāntakamskandakāndaṃ vindhyacakraṃ merukūṭaṃ mahendrakamākāśadhātri yadrūpaṃ pīṭhaṃ samyatra vāsinamādhāraṃ sarvadevānāṃ padmakaṇṭhakayānvitammamarūpaṃ sadā dhyātvā mamasarvātmamadhyamammama vā *(?) paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dakṣinadvāramālayamsarvadevālayasthāni sṛṣṭirūpaṃ sumadhyamamhṛdagrāmaṃ ca madhyasthaṃ nādarūpaṃ suśobhanamsabhāvāsaṃ sadājyotiḥ sadānṛttaṃ paraṃ gurumvimānotkṛṣṭakaṃ śuddhaṃ dakṣiṇadvāramālayamliṅgaṃ nādamayaṃ proktaṃ pīṭhaṃ bindusvarūpakamliṅgaśuddhi kramaṃ proktaṃ mantraśuddhikramaṃ śṛṇukriyākāle prayoktavyā steṣāṃ śuddhi samācaretakhilaṃ praṇavaṃ mantramādināma suniścatamsavaṃ ca mamarūpaṃ syāt oṅkāraṃ śuddhamavyayamyogena praṇavaṃ jñeyaṃ pañcadevātmakaṃ parammakārastālumadhyastho bindu bhrūmadhya niṣṭhitaḥakārassadyavaktraṃ syāt ukāro vāmavaktrakamnādastvīśānavaktraṃ syāt nadātītaṃ naṭeśvaramnakārassadyavaktraṃ tu makāro ghoravaktrakamyakāraḥ pauruṣaṃ vaktraṃ śrīmatpañcākṣaro bhavetākāśa bījavarge tu mantraṃ syādvādaśākṣaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvaṃ vidvantamastraṃ tu visargāntamabindukamādilopai natyalopairmadhyalopaiśca saṃyutamhakāraśśivarūpaṃ tu sakāraśśaktirūpakamśivaṃ sa saṃpradānaṃ ca yojayecchivaṃ mantrakamṣoḍaśākṣaravarṇe tu bindunādasamanvitamsāntaṃ hāntaṃ ca saṃyuktaṃ khatṛtīyākṣaraṃ tataḥmāntaṃ ṣaṣṭhasvaropetaṃ bindunādasamanvitamaṣṭamasya caturthārṇaṃ tatpūrvākṣarameva caṣaṭcaturdaśasaṃyuktaṃ aṣṭākṣaramidaṃ śubhampañcamaṃ pañcamaṃ nādaṃ saptavargadvitīyakamkūṭadīrghaṃ ca saptādi kūṭadīrghaṃ vaṣaḍantakamdvādaśākṣa * * * * *(?) yutaṃ homamācaretākarṣaṇaṃ yāmyabhāge naiṛtyāṃ mohanaṃ tathāsaumye vaśyaṃ prayoktavyaṃ īśāne māraṇaṃ tathāprāvṛṭkālamaparāhnaṃ sandhyā śiśirameva caākarṣaṇaṃ vasante tu grīṣme vidveṣaṇaṃ kuruśāntikaṃ tu śaratkāle hemante pauṣṭikaṃ tathādakṣiṇālayadaiśānye homakarma samācaretṣaṇmāsa madhyamāsaṃ vā nityaṃ hutvā hutārthakamnādaṃ sanādaṃ nādādyaṃ ṣaṣṭhavargasya pañcamamaṣṭamasyādi bījantu mūladīrgha samanvitamnāmamantramidaṃ guhyaṃ paraṃ jyotirvyavasthitamūrdhva śaivātmakaṃ mantraṃ madbhaktānāṃ pradeyakamdvitīyasya tṛtīyaṃ tu bindunādasamanvitampañcamasvāntimaṃ bījaṃ ṣaṣṭhapañcamabījakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madvitīyārṇa saṃyuktaṃ saptamasyādi bījakamṣaṣṭhavargatṛtīyaṃ tu pralayāgni samanvitamvāgbhavaṃ viṣṇubījaṃ tu binduśekharabhūṣitamviṣṇumantramidaṃ proktaṃ dhanamantrakramaṃ śṛṇudhanamantramidaṃ lakṣmī lakṣmīmantrakramaṃ śṛṇucaturthasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitamyavarga saptamaṃbījaṃ pañcamasvarasaṃyutamsarvaṃ śivamayaṃ mantraṃ svanāmādi namontakamkhabījasyādipaṃ mantraṃ mūlakārāṇi sṛṣṭikamādhāna śaktimanāsthānamajnyaṃ dharmādirudbhavamlokādhyāyaṃ ca yo devī muktādāmayya mūlavatdvādaśākṣaraṃ ca kṛnnāsā mūrdhvabandhaśiroruhāmvajraṭaṅkaṃ tomaraṃ ca jñānamudrāṃ ca vibhratīmbhāvayeddeśikodhīmān śaktimādhārarūpiṇīmśaktiṃ kuṅkuma varṇāṃ ca bījaṃ vidruma sannibhamdharmādi caraṇairyuktaṃ adhaścordhvaṃ ca saṃsthitamanantākhyāsanaṃ pūrvaṃ siṃhāsanamataḥ parampañcamaṃ vimalaṃ proktaṃ kalpayeduparikramātaṣṭanāgasamāyuktaṃ anantāsanamucyatedharmajñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ aiśvaryaṃ ca catuṣṭayamvairāgyaṃ siṃharūpaṃ syāt aiśvaryaṃ cāśvarūpakamrājāvartasvarūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ siṃhameva cacaturbhāge tu phalake mahādikṣu kramānnyasetsiṃhāsanakramaṃ proktaṃ yogāsanavidhiṃ śṛṇupraṇavaṃ pūrvatonyasyedakāraṃ cānale tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īkāraṃ paścimebhāge ukāraṃ vāyudeśakeṛkāraṃ madhyabhāge ca nyasedyogāsanaṃ bhavetvāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca kālīkalavikaraṇīsarvabhūtadamanī navamī ca manonmanīitthaṃ padmāsanaṃ proktaṃ śṛṇuṣva vimalāsanamtanno gaurī tu yāmye ca vāruṇe ca pracodayātagnimadhye ravisthānaṃ ravimadhye tu candramāḥātmānaṃ antarātmānaṃ paramātmānameva cabrahmavidyāṃ śivaṃ vidyāṃ guruvidyāṃ kramānnyasettatparaṃ rudratatvaṃ ca tata ūrdhvaṃ maheśvaratadūrdhve nādatatvaṃ ca śaktitatvamataḥparamtanmadhye netravāsaṃ ca tanmadhye kusumāsanamvṛttaṃ sadāśivaṃ rūpaṃ vyomarūpaṃ parātparambindumadhyagato nādo nādamadhyagato dhvaniḥśivaṃ parāparaṃ brahmamaprameyamaninditamśuddhatvāt śivamityuktaṃ parādūrdhvaṃ parātparampramāṇavyatiriktatvāt aprameyaṃ naṭeśvaramanaupamyaṃ asādṛśyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhamāśritamvyāpitvāt sarvagataṃ proktaṃ svāmitvāt prabhurucyatesādhakānāṃ hitārthaṃ ca sagrahet sveccayātanumsadāvṛttaṃ mahājyotirambayāllabhamīśvaramtatastaccatridhāproktaṃ niṣkalantu tathā punaḥniṣkalaṃ tu caturbhedaṃ sakalaṃ ca yathākramamśivatatvāt sahasrāṃśāt śāntināma samudbhavātasmāt caivaṃ sahasrāṃśāt śaktināma samudbhavā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmāccaiva sahasrāṃśāt nādamūrti samudbhavaḥtasmāt caiva sahasrāṃśāt bindutatva samudbhavaḥparaṃ bhāvaṃ samālambya sadā tāṇḍava sadguṇaiḥcaturthaṃ niṣkalaṃ hyevaṃ śivatatva samucyateityevaṃ niṣkalaṃ proktaṃ paraṃbhāvamiti smṛtamliṅgaṃ vīraṃ prakāreṇa sādākhyaṃ tatvalakṣaṇampīṭhe śaktissamudbhūtā nāmnā caiva manonmanīliṅgaṃ tu puṃstvamevaṃ syāt pīṭhaṃ strītatvameva caniṣkalā tu kalāhīnā sakalā tu kalānvitādhyānapūjānimittārthaṃ smṛtaṃ sakalaniṣkalamvarṇādhvā ca padādhvā ca tatvādhvā bhuvanādhvakaḥadhvasthānakramaṃ vakṣye viśeṣaṃ tu maheśvaratatvādhvā hṛdayaṃ caiva bhuvanādhvā tu romakamkalādhvā caiva sarvāṅgaṃ itthaṃ sādākhyarūpakamatheśānādi sadyāntaṃ kalpayettu sadāśivampuruṣeṇa tu catvāri vaktrāṇi parikalpayetvāmadevena mantreṇa guhyādyaṅgāni kalpayetaṣṭatrayodaśāṣṭau ca catvāraścaiva pañca caevaṃ tu sakalaṃ proktaṃ niṣkalaṃ tāṇḍavaṃ śubhamsādākyaṃ sarvadeveśaṃ pratyakṣaṃ sarvatomukhamyuvānaṃ pañcamūrdhānaṃ daśabāhuṃ caturmukhamdvipādaṃ sphaṭikākāraṃ śvetayajñopavītikamabhayaṃ śūlaparaśuṃ vajraṃ khaḍgaṃ ca dakṣiṇebibhraccandrāṃśu śiśiraṃ saumyaṃ śuklāmvarānvitamsarvāvayavasaṃyuktaṃ sarvagandhānulepanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcabhūtādhidaivatyaṃ pañcabrahmasvarūpakamityetairlakṣaṇairyuktaṃ sādākhyaṃ tu svarūpakamvahniruṣṇatvavacchaktirapināhāvinīvibhoḥ* * (?) na śaktikopetātvākhyayā tu manonmanīlokapālāssaśastrāśca kramaśastassamudbhavāḥsarvāvayava saṃpūrṇāstvanantāditya sa prabhātatsādākhya prabhāvastu varṇitaṃ naiva śakyatemūrtayastvīśvarādyāśca sakalaṃ iti kīrtitāḥbrahmādyāvaraṇaṃ caiva pūrvavat parikalpayetvidyātatva sthitaṃ śaṃbhuṃ sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyutamliṅgapūjāvasāne tu pūjayedīśvaraṃ kramātcaturbhuja triṇetrastu candrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥsarvāvayavasaṃpūrṇāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥīśvarasya tu koṭyaṃśāt brahmatatva samudbhavaḥkamaṇḍalvakṣamālāsṛk pītavarṇa sulocanaḥrudraḥ saṃhāramūrtīnāṃ viṣṇuśca sthitimūrtikaḥmūrtitrayastu saṃproktaṃ brahmāṇḍe saṃvyavasthitambhogasthānaṃ tu sakalaṃ layādhikārabhogavānsakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ caiva tvaparaṃ paripaṭhyatetisṛstu devatāḥ paścāt trayastriṃśat samudbhavāḥvasavoṣṭāśvinau dvau tu trayastriṃśaccadevatāḥśarīraṃ bhūtasāreṇa devānāṃ tu sṛjanti vaisarvakāraṇa deveśa dhyātvā tāṇḍavamīśvarammūlaṃ smṛtvā paraṃ dhyātvā sarvavyāpi sadāśivaḥsthāpanaṃ vāmamantreṇa tvaghoreṇa nirodhayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathā kuṇḍagataścāgnirvāyunā paridīpyateāvāhyānākhyayāvāhyasthāpinyā sthāpyamudrayāniṣṭhunā liṅgamādrāṃ ca padmanetrāstramudrikāgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ caiva pradāpayetliṅgamūlaṃ tu caraṇau liṅgāgraṃ mukhamucyateīśvarāddakṣiṇāṃśe tu brahmā sṛṣṭhyarthamudyataḥnāsāyāṃ vāyurutpanna śrotrayostu diśodaśahṛdayeṣāṃ mukho jāto bhāskaro nābhisaṃbhavaḥvāmanetrasudbhūto devassoma iti smṛtaḥhastāgrādāyudhodbhūti ratyāścaiva nakhodbhavāḥpādayossarvadevānāṃ śivajñānasya codbhavaḥliṅgamūrti svarūpasya madhye sādākhyamarcayetpañcāsya pañcamūrdhānaṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanamaṣṭaśrotra dvipādaṃ ca kiñcit prahasitānanamcakraṃ ca jñānamudrāṃ ca savyabhāge bhayaṃ kramātvaradaṃ vismayaṃ caiva vibhrāṇaṃ vāmapāṇibhiḥsadyavāmādi mantreṇa sthāpayet pūrvavat śubhamvaktreṣu vaktramantreṇa dadyādācamanīyakammukheṣu gandhaṃ vāmena puṣpamīśena mūrdhasunaivedyaṃ vaktramantreṇa kramāddadyānmaheśvarapañcabrahma ṣaḍaṅgaiśca kalpayeddhenumudrayavāruṇaṃ bījamuccārya jalabhāṇḍe tu pūjayetcaturdikṣu catuṣkoṇeṣvācamārghyaṃ pradāpayetkṣīraṃ tu rudradaivatyaṃ maheśoṃ dadhi cocyatepañcasāre tu naivedyaṃ darśayedjñānamudrikām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcagavyaṃ kramaṃ proktaṃ phalodaka vidhiṃ śṛṇuāmra kelīphalaṃ phalaṃ caiva tintriṇīvaphalodakamphalodaka vidhiṃ prokto bījodakavidhiṃ śṛṇusaugandhikaṃ hemaśālī bījodakamidaṃ śubhambījodakavidhi proktaṃ ratnodakavidhiṃ śṛṇupravālaṃ sphaṭikaṃ nīlaṃ muktā ratnodakaṃ śubhamitthaṃ ratnodakaṃ proktaṃ gandhodakavidhiṃ śṛṇukarpūraṃ pichilā caiva kastūrī cāgarustathāgandhādikaṃ tu naivedyaṃ nāmamantreṇa dāpayetcaṃpaka prasavaṃ caiva mallikā caiva pāṭalīnandyāvartaṃ śriyāvartaṃ mandāraṃ karavīrakamgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca śivamantreṇa dāpayetathānnairabhiṣekaṃ tu āyurārogyavardhanamtasmādannābhiṣekaṃ tu mamaprītikaraṃ śubhamannapūjāvidhiṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nabhūtanna bhaviṣyatiannaliṅgākṛtiṃ datvā gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dhūpakamannapūjāvidhiṃ nityaṃ śubhagtsarvarthakāraṇamannapuṣpaṃ mahāvāśyaṃ dakṣiṇārādhanottamamambātmabīja paramaṃ tasmādannamudāhṛtamtasmāt sarvaprayatnena anne naiva prapūjayetgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ caiva pradāpayetsamuccarannāmamantramabhiṣiñcecchanaiḥśanaiḥdhyātvā samuccarannāma gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dāpayetpūṣeti mantrau dvau sarvaṃ sarvatrāpi samuccaretpūrvavat saṃskṛtaṃ toyaṃ hemapātre prapūritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tajjalasya tu madhyasthaṃ sthāpayed dakṣiṇeśvaramgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ caiva pradāpayetsarvasiddhikaraṃ śuddhaṃ sarvaroga vināśanamīleśannaśca kadrudrannamaste sadasasyatiḥaghora tatpūruṣo vāma sadyasvādiṣṭayā tataḥyedevānna āmāno gaurīṃ devāha vaipi caomityetadbṛhatsāmaṃ bibetāpraṇavādikampṛthak pṛthak sakṛjjaptvābhiṣiñcecchanaiśśanaiḥsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi tathā tāmra samudbhavamathavā mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi snānapātraṃ praśasyateāḍhakāpūrṇamadhamaṃ sarvamevāḍhakaṃ bhavetsūtreṇa veṣṭayet sarvaṃ gavākṣa sadṛśāntaraḥāḍhakaṃ tadardhaṃ vā kalaśānāṃ pṛthak pṛthaksakūrcānvastrasaṃyuktān saratnān sthaṇḍile sthitānkalaśasya mukhe raudraṃ madhye mādhavadaivatamgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca hṛdayena pradāpayetarūpamapi rūpasthaṃ dakṣiṇadvāramīśvarampūjāsthāna dvayaṃguhyaṃ dakṣiṇālayamadbhutamnāmamantraṃ samuccārya triyakṣaramanusmaranśuddhatoyena saṃpūjya **(?) drālepanaṃ tathāgandhodakaistataśśuddhairabhiṣiñcecchanaiśśanaiḥpādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ tatkāle tu pradāpayetliṅgapīṭhaṃ sthalaṃ caiva vasanaṃ tatpraveśayetvāstoṣpatīti mantreṇa vāstunāthaṃ samarcayetsūkṣmavastraṃ tu saṅgrāhya bandhīyāddhṛtayāṇunā

sanskrit: īśānādi ca sadyāntaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ vinyaset kramāttadante darpaṇaṃ dadyāt śaktimantraṃ samuccarantataśchatraṃ cāmaraṃ ca hṛdayena pradāpayetpuṣpāñjaliṃ dadet paścāt namaskārākhyamudrayājvālāpātrāṇi śirasā hastābhyāṃ ca nivedayethemakumbhasthitajale dīpaṃ pūrve tu nikṣipetpuṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥ kṛtvā japalakṣaṇamucyatemānasaṃ caiva kaṇṭhoṣṭhmupāṃśuṃ vyaktameva caprātarusāgye tathābhyarcya madhyāhne ca nivedayetekadīpaṃ dvikāle ca rātrau dīpadvayaṃ bhavetsāyecāsyāṃtamabhyarcya dīpaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ bhavetdīpaṃ caiva catuḥproktāssāye tu dviguṇaṃ bhavetprasthadvayaṃ dvikāle ca dīpaṃ viṃśatikaṃ bhavettrikālaṃ baliliṅgena balidānaṃ nayedbudhāḥardhayāme tadardhaṃ ca caturviṃśatidīpakamtrikāle valisaṃyuktaṃ puṣpānnākṣata vai kramātmadhyāhne nityahomasyāddhūpadīpa samanvitamtrikālañca nivedyaṃ ca pañcāṃśaṃ dīpasaṃyutamuttamādadhamaṃ tatra trikālandroṇamāharettrikālamannaliṅgaṃ syāt trikālaṃ homasaṃyutamaṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā śataṃ vā rudrakanyakāḥmadhyamā madhyamaṃ tatra trikāle tu caturhaviḥdroṇena śuddhamannaṃ ca pacitvā tu pṛthak pṛthaktrikāle balihomaṃ syāt śītārī dhūpamādiśetgaṇikāṣṭa śatopetaṃ stotra dhvanisamākulam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uttamottamamuddiśya haviṣyaṃ kramamucyatetadardhamardharātraṃ tu dīpāḥ pañcaśataṃ śubhamtrikālaṃ balihomaṃ syāt sarvavādya samanvitamevaṃ navavidhaṃ proktaṃ pāyasādi śṛṇu kramāttaṇḍulādviguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ kadalīphalasaṃyutampāyasānnamidaṃ proktaṃ kṛsarānnaṃ tataḥ śṛṇutaccaturthāṃśamājyaṃ tu pācayitvā yathāvidhiardhabhāraṃ gulaṃ kṛtvā bhārārdhaṃ vātha taṇḍulamghṛtadroṇārdhamardhaṃ vā śṛṇu pācakalakṣaṇamśvetayajñopavītaśca śuklavastradharaśśubhaḥbījamukhyena mantreṇa śodhayitvā vicakṣṇaḥśikhayā jvālayedagniṃ astreṇaitān pratāpayetnirīkṣyanetramantreṇa pakvaṃ caiva caruṃ tataḥtatpūruṣeṇa mantreṇa supakvaṃ tu parīkṣayetekāṅgulaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ ca pātrāṇāṃ bhasmanā nyasetpātrāṇi ca tathā sarvamindhaṃ caiva supūjayetmaṇṭape paścime bhāge nyasenmantrī yathākramamsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ athavā kadalīdalamsthūlī pādatrayaṃ kṛtvā tripādī madhyamasthitamsauvarṇaṃ pātramādāya sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutamhaviṣādriṃ samudgaṃ ca naivedyaṃ syāt śivasya tuphalaissarvopadaṃśaiśca gavyenājyena saṃyutambadhnīyāt saurabhīṃ mudrāṃ hṛdayārṇaṃ samuccarancaturbhāgaikabhāgena parivāra balirbhavetcaturbhāgaikabhāgena pātraśeṣamihocyate

sanskrit: punarācamanaṃ datvā sugandhena jalena caphalebhya striguṇaṃ patraṃ dāpayet tailasaṃyutamsarvadravyaviśeṣaṃ tu dadyāt caṇḍeśvarāya capaśubhiśca gajairbhojyaṃ prakṣipet salileṣu vāyathā svasya gurocchiṣṭaṃ bhojyaṃ tat putraśiṣyayoḥete ekādaśāḥ proktāḥ garbhāvaraṇa śaktayaḥanantādi śikhaṇḍyantaṃ prāgdalādi kramānnyasetekarudrastrimūrtiśca śrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍinaḥṭaṅkatriśūlamabhayaṃ vahantovarameva caaruṇaṃ cāñjana prakhyaṃ kramādvidyeśa varṇakamśrutirmedhā tathoṣṭau ca vidyeśānāṃ tu śaktayaḥuttare tu yajedgaurīṃ vṛṣabhaṃ pūrvato yajetmahākālaṃ tu naiṛtyāṃ bhṛṅgīśaṃ vāyugocaredvinetrā dvibhujā śyāmā gaurīkaradhṛtotpalāgajānana triṇetrastu kuṅkumābhaścaturbhujaḥcaturbhuja triṇetrastu japākusumasannibhaḥkṛtāñjalipuṭaśrīmānvajracāre ca dhārakamkhaḍgaṃ savajramabhayaṃ vahaṃtomarameva cadhūmravarṇaṃ tu bhṛṅgī **(?) yeddussvapnanāśanamnīlavarṇo bhayavaro vibhracchūlaṃ paraśvathamnetradvādaśakopeto vibhradvādaśabāhubhiḥghaṇṭāṃ ca śikhinaṃ kheṭaṃ ghaṇṭaṃ nāgaṃ tathāṅkuśambhadrā ca vedadhānā ca kuntikāpī ca mantikāgaṇeśāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ loke"ṣāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇuyamaṃ daṇḍadharaṃ yāmye khaḍgaṃ niṛtiṃ saṃyajet

sanskrit: vāyumaṃśalahastaṃ ca vāyavyāndiśi pūjayetīśānamīśadigbhāge śūlahastaṃ prapūjayetśvetavarṇaṃ ca dhūmraṃ ca lokeśānāṃ kramāt prabhāḥvṛṣabhaśca kramādaṣṭau vāhanāni ca digbhṛtāmkālakaṇṭhī ca nīlī ca jitakānistu devikālokeśāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ saurāvaraṇamucyatesarasvatī ca jyeṣṭhā ca viṣṇuśca kṣetrapālakaḥsphaṭikaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ tu śyāmaṃ kṛṣṇaprabhāḥ kramātsāvitrī caiva kalyāṇī jñānī cānādadāyinīsauramāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ mayāstrāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇugadātriśūlaṃcakraṃ ca padmaṃ caivada daśāyudhamśeṣāśca puruṣākārā ekavaktradvibāhukāḥpadmarāgaṃ pravālaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ śvetaṃ ca raktakamnīlinī sumukhī caiva marddanī bhṛṅgamālinīastrāvaraṇamityuktaṃ dalādhastāt prapūjayetbrāhmīmāheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathāvīrabhadraṃ ca vighneśaṃ pūrvasyāṃ diśi pūjayetsarvabhūtapiśācebhyo balipīṭhe baliṃ kṣipetantarhārāsu madhye tu vāhanaṃ pīṭhamucyatemadhyādiṣu pratiṣṭhesu gaṇapīṭhaṃ prakalpayetgandhapuṣpodanairyuktaṃ dhūpadīpasamanvitammahāpīṭhercanaṃ kṛtvā sarvadevagaṇānvitamyakṣāśca rāṣasāścaiva nāgabhūtāḥ piśācakāḥanāvaṣṭirgaṇāścaiva rohiṇī gaṇarāva cadevadānavagandharva pīṭhamadhye prajāpatiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vṛṣaṃ tu pūrvadigbhāge dakṣiṇeśaṃ tu dakṣiṇegajādyairarcayitvā tu baliṃ sarvatra dāpayetprajāpatestu devānāṃ ṛṣīṇāṃ ca yathākramammārjanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā punarabhyarcanaṃ śubhammuṣṭimātraṃ tadardhaṃ vā baliṃ sarvatra dāpayetagnikāryavidhiṃ vakṣye sarvasiddhiphalapradamtisroretā pūrvamukhyo brahmaviṣṇuharādhipāḥsūryakāntodbhavaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ araṇyudbhavameva casauvarṇe rājane tāmre satpātre mṛṇmayethavāśodhayedastramantreṇa kavacenāvakuṇṭhayotkuṇḍevā sthaṇḍilevāpi sapuṣpaṃ viṣṭaraṃ nyasettasya madhye samāvāhya vāgīśīyāgakāriṇīmpaścānmaheśvaraṃ devaṃ triṇetraṃ ca caturbhujamsaṃhṛṣṭaṃ sahavāgīśīṃ devyā tatrāpi bhāvayetagnisthābhimukhaṃ yonau devāssadyāssamuccaranpaścāt saptāhutiṃ kuryāt hṛnmantraṃ samyaguccaranpuṃsavane tu śirasā saptadhā homamācaretnāmakarmavidhāne ca hṛdā saptāhutiryajetcaulakarmavratavidhau hṛnmantreṇa ca saptadhāvivāhāya ca hṛnmantraṃ saptadhā homayedguruḥevaṃ kramāttu homena śivāgnerjātakaṃ śubhamagramagreṇa saṃspṛśya madhyaṃ madhyena saṃspṛśetajyasthālīṃ carusthālīṃ praṇītāpātrameva capraṇītāṃ pūrayettoyaiḥ tatra kūrcaṃ ca nikṣipetājyena pātramājyasa pūrayitvā sakūrcakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paścime uttare caiva ājyasthāpanamācaretnirīkṣaṇaṃ ca netreṇa paridhi sthāpanaṃ kuruindrādīśānaparyantān paridhisthān prapūjayetekarūpaṃ dvivaktraṃ ca catuśṛṅgaṃ dvināsikamsopavītaṃ jaṭamauliṃ saptajihvābhirāvṛtamatiriktā bahurūpā jihvā saptaprakīrtitāḥraktā tathottare bhāge kṛṣṇāyāmyadiśisthitāaiśānye bahurūpā ca jihvāsthānaṃ prakīrtitamagnidevasya madhye tu sādākhyaṃ supratiṣṭhitampādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dhūpakamsamidhā hṛdaye naiva aghoreṇa caruṃ hunetvāmamantreṇa saktuṃ ca kṣīraṃ **(?)dyamantrataḥtilamīśānamantreṇa mudgaṃ māṣaṃ hṛdaṃ tathājaptvaṃ śataṃ varṇamantraṃ odanena tu homayetpañcāvarṇa devānāṃ ekahomaṃ pṛthak pṛthaktāmbūlaṃ dāpayet paścāt gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ pradāpayetagnerāliṅganaṃ nityaṃ vidadhyācchivarūpiṇamlalāṭe bāhuhṛdaye vekāṅgulaṃ tripuṇḍrakammūlaṃ trikoṇa madhye tu sthāpayedagnidevatāmkoṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ dhyāyennādātmakaṃ naṭamagnikāryakramam proktaṃ nityotsavavidhiṃ śṛṇusarvasiddhikaraṃ śuddhaṃ sarvapāpaviśodhanamyakṣarākṣasapaiśācabhūtānāgāstathaiva cadakṣiṇe maṇṭapādbhāge caturaśraṃ tu maṇḍalamsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kāṃsyaṃ vā pātramucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatrāṣṭadalapadmaṃ ca kārayedvyaṅgulonnatamevaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa pātraṃ tu maṇḍalaṃ nyasetpuṣpaliṅgaṃ tu pūrvāhne sāyāhneḥ taṇḍulātmakamuttamaṃ cāḍhakaṃ proktaṃ madhyamaṃ tu tadardhakamnāpakvaṃ nātipakvaṃ ca nātyuṣṇaṃ nātiśītalamutsedhaṃ dvādaśāṅgulyaṃ mūlaṃ tadviguṇaṃ bhavetmadhyamaṃ dvādaśāṅgulyaṃ ūrdhvaṃ tu tryaṅgulaṃ bhavetsaṃpūjya vidyāvaraṇaṃ devadhyānakramaṃ śṛṇuakṣasūtraṃ triśūlaṃ ca bibhrāṇāmabhayaṃ varampadmamudrāṃ namaskāraṃ śāntimudrāṃ prakalpayetdaśāyudhāni paritaḥ kalpayet kalpavittamaḥtriśūlaṃ pūrvato gacchet śivadaṇḍātvanantarepavitrapāṇi maunī tu hastamātreṇa daṇḍadhṛkpūrvāhne brahmaprītiṃ ca madhyāhne tu śivapriyaḥpūrvoktaṃ brahmavarṇam tu rudravarṇaṃ tu kathyatemadhyāhne dhārayelliṅgaṃ mama prītikaraṃ śubhamsāyāhne dhārayelliṅgaṃ viṣṇuprītikaraṃ śubhamtanmūrdhniṃ deyaṃ saṃsthāpya gandhapuṣpādibhiryajetathavā pādagamanaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ tu kārayetkāhalaistālajaṃghaiśca vīṇāveṇuravaistathāgaṇikānṛtta saṃyuktaṃ divyageya samanvitamvedadhvanisamāyuktaṃ divyanṛttasamanvitamādyaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt bhṛṅga tālasamanvitamtāladvayasamāyuktaṃ vedadhvaniniṣevitamsamastaṃ bhṛṅgiṇī tālaṃ kartṛvādyaṃ tu ṭaṅkarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bāhyapīṭhe kramāvṛtya prāsādaṃ triḥpradakṣiṇamnavatākaṃ nāgatālaṃ koṭikāṃsaṃ kariṣya caityete kalpitāścaiva prāsādaṃ triḥpradakṣiṇamhṛdayaṃ mantramuccārya gandhapuṣpādinārcayetpratimaṃ pratiliṅgantu pūjayet pūrvavacchubhampūjayeddevadeveśaṃ namaskuryāccamudrayāpradakṣiṇaṃ duḥkhaharaṃ somasūtraṃ na laṅghayetpradakṣiṇasamaṃ nāsti pratyakṣaphalasiddhidamdvibhedalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣvevaṃ maheśvarachāyādhastāt prakartavyaṃ vimāne tu pradakṣiṇamna doṣamanyakāleṣu chāyāsūtraṃ na laṅghayetśivaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ śaṃbhoḥ jagadrakṣārthakāraṇamāyurbalaṃ tathārogyaṃ apamṛtyu jayo bhavetpradakṣiṇe vimānānāṃ dakṣiṇaṃ śreṣṭhamucyatejñānārthaṃ ca jayārthaṃ ca vaśyārthaṃ ca dhanārthakamaṇimā guṇimārthaṃ ca pradakṣiṇamihocyatedakṣiṇe dvāradevaṃ tu naṭeśvara manusmaretśirohastau ca karṇau ca cibukaṃ bāhuyugmakamśiro hastau dvibāhū ca kṛtvā jānu ca saṃsthitautadante tāṇḍavaṃ kṛtvā mamaprītikaraṃ śubhamliṅgamāliṅganaṃ kuryāt jñānamudrāmanantarambaliliṅgaṃ tatobhyarcya bāhyapīṭhe tu nikṣipetkauśikaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā sāyāhne cendulaṃ śubhamapamṛtyu praśamanam āyurārogyavardhanamdānakṣapaṇayogena dīkṣācetyabhidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gaṅgātīre saritpuṇye samudre cāśramepi caparvatāgre vane goṣṭhe śrīpurekṣīravṛkṣakedevālaye viśeṣeṇa dakṣiṇadvāraveśmanidīkṣāsthāna kramaṃ proktaṃ dīkṣākālavidhiṃ śṛṇuayane viṣuve caiva grahṇe somasūryayoḥsumuhūrte sulagne ca dīkṣākarma samācaretguṇayuktāṃstu saṅgrāhya guṇahīnānvivarjayetpūrvavadvidhisaṃyuktaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥpūrvavadbhūmi saṃśuddhiṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapamaṇḍanamśvetavarṇaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ raktavarṇaṃ tu bhūbhṛtāḥājyagandhaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ raktagandhakammadhuraṃ ca kaṣāyaṃ ca tiktaṃ ca kaṭukaṃ kramātvarṇagandharasairevaṃ saṃyuktaṃ yāgabhūtalamvitānadhvajasaṃyuktaṃ darbhamālā vibhūṣitamkramukaiḥ kadalībhiśca muktādāmābhirāvṛtamsudhayā bhasmanāvāpi kṛtamekhātrayāvṛtamsumitaṃ ca susūtraṃ ca kṛtvā śaṅkuṃ ca sarvataḥutsedhā dvādaśāṅgulyāstadardhaṃ nāhasaṃyutāḥpūrvāgrāhyuttarāgrāṇi sūtrāṇyāsphālayet kramātsūtraṃ prasārya kṛtvā tu vartale maṇḍale śubhekarṇikāṃ pītavarṇena kesaraṃ caruṇena capadmahastapramāṇaṃ tu karṇikā caturaṅgulampratidvāreṇa rekhāsu padmabāhye trayaṃ bhavetpadmānte prativāre tu madhye varṇakramaṃ śṛṇupaścimeśvetavarṇaṃ syāt uttare kāñcanaprabham

sanskrit: vāyvyāṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ syāt aiśānyāṃ śvetavarṇakamcaturdvārādivarṇaṃ tu kramādvakṣye maheśvaraharitena tu bāhyena trivarṇaṃ ca kramānyasetśāligodhūmapiṣṭaiśca muktācūrṇasumiśritamāgneye pītacūrṇaiśca nīlacūrṇayametathāmuktācūrṇaṃ paścime ca vaidūryaṃ cūrṇamāniledhātuśca puṣpayoniśca brahmapuṣpaṃ ca utpalaiḥharidrāśālivarṇaṃ ca madhyādīśānavarṇakaiḥkalpaṃ bilvaṃ śamīṃ caiva vaṭavṛkṣaṃ ca caṃpakamṣoḍaśaṃ caiva dvātriṃśat catuṣṣaṣṭyuttaraṃśatamsahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā ṣoḍaśa dvādaśāṣṭavāpañcaviṃśati dvātriṃśat sahasraṃ vā śatāṣṭakammaṇḍalaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ tato hastavidhiṃ śṛṇuyūkāṣṭakayavāṣṭaṃ ca aṅgulyaṣṭa dvitālakamekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā caturhastamathāpi vāhastānāṃ viṃśatiṃ caiva pañcaviṃśati hastakammaṇḍalaṃ tu kṛtaṃ pūjya tasya madhye śivārcanamgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ caiva pradāpayetapūpaṃ tu phalaṃ kṣīraṃ astramantreṇa dāpayetnivedayet caruṃ samyak tadardhantu nivedayetdantairaspṛśya vidhivat pañcabrahma manusmarantadante mantramuccārya śiṣyakarṇe tu dakṣiṇetriyambakaṃ śataṃ japtvā badhnīyāt kautukaṃ puraḥstrīṇāmapi ca śūdrāṇāṃ amantraṃ vāmahastakebhasmaśayyā samārūḍhaṃ śivadakṣiṇapārśvake

sanskrit: tatkāle gururūpaṃ tu dhyātvā dakṣiṇanāyakamsasūtraṃ ca savastraṃ ca saratnaṃ pūrvavat kṛtampuruṣādi ca vāmānta pūrvādyuttarato nyasethṛdayaṃ mantramuccārya naivedyādiṃ ca dāpayetśubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vāpi duṣṭasvapnanivedayetprakṣālya pādau hastau ca samācamya vidhānataḥathavā navavastreṇa kārpāsavihitena vāuttarābhimukho **(?) badhnīyāttu samāhitaḥīśānena tu mantreṇa puṣpāñjalimupāharetyasminvastre patetpuṣpaṃ nāmātmaṃ tu tadātmakamśaivatatvaṃ ca kālaṃ ca mūrtī śaktikramācchṛṇurudraṃ vāmamahaṃkāro navadhānāma kathyatesadyādiranulomasya "ṣaktyantaṃ nāma bhāṣayetagastyagautamo vasiṣṭhāḥ parāśaraścaivaromaśaḥbindusūtraṃ viṣṇusūtraṃ paścādvāyavyasūtrakamśivaḥ śikhānandajyotsnā sāvitrisadguṇaḥkalpo bilva śamī caiva vaṭavṛkṣaśca campakammāṇikyaṃ mauktikaṃ caiva puṣparāgaṃ ca nīlakamsphāṭikaṃ caiva ratnāni navadhā kīrtitāni caanādi śaivaṃ tṛtīyaṃ anuśaivaṃ caturthakamsaptamaṃ bhedaśaivaṃ syāt aṣṭamaṃ guṇaśaivakamśivatatvaṃ vahnitatvaṃ śaktijñānamayaṃ tataḥproktāni navatatvāni kālannava śṛṇu kramātsaṃhārakāle rudrastu bhogakāle maheśvaraḥdhvanikāle tu nādātmā ājñākālestu śaktayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivamūśśaktimūrtiṃ nādātmā bindumūrtikaḥmartayo navadhā proktāḥ śaktīrapi tataḥ śṛṇujñānaśaktirjayāśakti yogānandākhyaśaktikāḥnāmādi bhedāssaṃproktādvāravarṇakramaṃ śṛṇupūrvadvāraṃ praśastaṃ tu brāhmaṇānāṃ maheśvaraśūdrāṇāṃ paścimadvāraṃ viśeṣaṃ tu maheśvarapañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgaiśca pūrvavannyāsamācaretmūlamantraṃ sakṛjjaptvā śiṣyamūrdhni nirīkṣayetsaṃśrāvya samayaṃ samyak devadevasya cāgrataḥācārya jyeṣṭhaliṅgānāṃ chāyāmapi na laṅghayetnirmālyaṃ tu na bhuñjīta bhasmayuktānna nindayetevaṃ saṅgrāhya samayān paścāddhoma samācaretśabdasaṃrodhana sthānaṃ karṇendriyamiti smṛtamnīra***(?) karṇaṃ tu cakṣu prāṇe sujihvakesamayendriyamānena ahaṃkārenalendriyampañcabījakaraṃ nyastvā pūrvendriya nyaset kramātevaṃ nirudhya vidhivat karṣayecchivaśaktibhiḥsudhayā plāvayet tatra vāruṇyena śivena casūryamaṇḍalasaṅkāśaṃ madhyabījaṃ pratiṣṭhitamśivatatvamitiprakhyaṃ mantrarājānamavyayampūrvamevaṃ sakumbhitvāt paścācchiṣye niyojayetindranīlamaṇiprakhyaṃ pañcaviṃśātmarūpakamādyanta śūnyamadhyasthaṃ ānandamamṛtātmakamparavastu svarūpaṃ ca paramānandarūpiṇamaṣṭamādyā mamadhvaṃ syāt mudgasya pratiṣṭhitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sadāśiva śivātmānam ṣaḍadhvātmā sulakṣitammantrādhvā ca padādhvā ca tatvādhvā bhuvanādhvakampṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva capārthivaṃ tu nivṛttāvai brāhmaṇāñcaiva kathyatetejo vidyā ca tejo vai yāvadrudrasvarūpakamśāntyātītaṃ khakārātmā sādākhyaṃ tatvamavyayamvidyāsthānaṃ tu karṇāntaṃ mukhāntaṃ śāntigocaramnivṛttau sadyamantraṃ syāt pratiṣṭhāyāṃ tu vāmakamīśānamantrotītāyāṃ tanmantrairjuhuyāt tataḥpañcatriṃśacchataṃ hutvā pañcahomamaṃ praśasyateanye vandhavināśāya hṛdayena śataṃ hunetvarṇamantraṃ samuccārya ekahomaṃ praśasyateākarṣayettu tatsarvaṃ pāśabandhavināśanamchinnaṃ bhinnaṃ ca tanyūnāṃ pāśabandhanamucyatepradāpayettu yatkāle śivamantramanusmaranvidyeśvarāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ āhutyaṣṭakamiṣyatelokapālaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ caiva homayetpṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva cavākpāṇi ca pādau ca pāyūpasthau ca pañcakammanobuddhirahaṃkāraḥ prakṛtiḥ puruṣastathāśuddhavidyā śuddhakalā tathā paścāt sadāśivaḥevaṃ tatvāni ṣaṭtriṃśat svasvasthāne niyojayetkālāgni rudraṃ prathamaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhe niyojayetaṣṭāviṃśati koṭyaṃ tu narakāditidāruṇaḥrauravaṃ kubhighoraṃ ca mahāghoraṃ ca rauravam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kantupūtaśca taptaśca asthitālavaśaṃ tathāśvānasūkaravyāghraṃ ca siṃha caiva gajendrakāḥkṛkamaścañca kāmāśca kukkuṭaścaiva gardabhaḥnīlayantrā ca yantrāśca cakrayantrāḥ subhīrukāḥtalaṃ ca vitalaṃ caiva talaṃ vasutalaṃ tathāūrumadhye nyaset paścāt kramāt pātālasaptakamjanalokaṃ tapolokaṃ satyalokaṃ yathākramamaindraṃ brāhmaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ raudrameva cabhūlokaṃ śivalokaṃ ca galādūrdhvaṃ prakalpayetmūlaprakṛti bījaṃ tu mukhaṃ madhye pravinyasetnāsāgre hṛdaye guhye dehamadhye tu vinyasetnivṛtti hṛtpradeśe ca pratiṣṭhā karṇagocareitthaṃ kalā ca dhvānaṃ śivatatvaṃ tataḥ paramrasabandhaṃ tathā tāmraṃ na bhūyastā bhṛtāṃ vrajetevaṃ samyak tataḥ kṛtvā dīkṣā nānādivarjitāhṛdayena carutsaṅghaṃ aghoreṇa caruṃ tataḥhṛdayena gulaṃ paścāt phalaṃ ca śivamantrataḥyavā hṛdayamantreṇa siddhārthaṃ sadyamantrataḥdravyābhāṣe tu sarveṣāṃ ājyahomaḥ praśasyatehomānterabhiṣekaṃ ca vakṣyate tu śṛṇu kramātśatāṣṭa kalśairvāpi sarvadravya samanvitaiḥpañcaviṃśatitaḥ kṛtvā athavā navapañcavāpūrvavat sthāpya kalaśaṃ śivaṃ pūrvavadācarettatpadmamadhye śiṣyaṃ tu sthāpayeduttarānanamṛgvedaṃ pūrvadigbhāge yajurvedaṃ tu dakṣiṇe

sanskrit: vinyasedghoṣayet paścāt śaṅkhakāhakanisvanaiḥvīṇāveṇuravaiścaiva nṛttagāna samanvitaiḥśaivaiḥ pāśupataiścaiva mahāvratatarairapivasanāsanadaṇḍādyai bhojane **(?)toṣitaiḥabhyarcya pūrvavat kṛtvā nyāsaṃ tasya yathākramamniṣkalantu yathācāryassakalaṃ ca tathā bhavetācāmaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā gandhapuṣpairalaṅkṛtamhārakeyūrakaṭakakuṇḍalābharaṇojvalamcandanāliptasarvāṅgaṃ puṣpamālādyalaṅkṛtamsapavitra karābhyāṃ tu dhārayettoya puṣpakampraṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau śirasā bhaktisaṃyutamśaṅkhakāhala saṃyuktaṃ puṣpavṛṣṭi samanvitampaścāt prāsādamuccāryavaradaṃ dakṣiṇātmakamśiṣyasya dakṣiṇe karṇe śivamantraṃ samuccaretpūjāpādamidaṃ jñānaṃ prajñāpādaṃ padaṃ vadekarmātmakaṃ ca śaivaṃ ca mamā prākṣi kathaṃ prabhoācārya jyeṣṭhaliṅgānāṃ chāyāmapi na laṅghayetadīkṣitākṛtiṃ spṛṣṭvā śivamantra manusmaretmama rūpaṃ sadā dhyātvā śivamantraṃ sadā japetśivārcanaṃ tathā dharmaṃ japaṃ dhyānaṃ ca kārayettraivarṇiko viśeṣeṇa sarvakālaṃ tu dhārayetnamaskārādi svāhāntaṃ kṣatriyaṃ mantramucyatenamo vaṣaṭ śūdrāsya praṇavādi vivarjayetna jātibheda varṇāśca nnirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ padamnirvāṇadīkṣā vakṣye tava snehācchṛṇu kramāt

sanskrit: aṣṭādalaṃ padmākhyastvā madhye kuṃbhaṃ pratiṣṭhayetaṅkurārpaṇa pūrve tu sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyutamgandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca pūrvavat pūjayet kramātatha vārādi tīre vā karābhyāmabhiṣecayetdakṣiṇāmukhamāśritya sāsanaṃ caiva pūjayettṛtīyaṃ dṛṃhaṇaṃ kṛtvā caturthaṃ tu vadābhayamdakṣiṇaṃ mukhamāśritya sanmārgaṃ caikathyateputravat svīkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tadante śivasaṃyutamdāsamārgaṃ viśeṣaṃ tu mama rūpaṃ tu tatsamamsanmārgaṃ sakhamārgaṃ ca putramārgaṃ ca sādhakamtasmādvedāsamārgaṃ tu nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ padamtasmādācārya rūpaṃ tu mahaṃ devātmarūpakamtasmāddevamidaṃ guhyaṃ dhyāyayet paramāṃ gatimśvānayoniśataṃ prāpya caṇḍāleṣvapi jāyateācāraṃ liṅgamūrtiṃ ca gururātma prapūjayetkecidyadi ca nityānta nṛttā kecittu yanti canayana dīkṣāṃ tu saṃproktaṃ sparśadīkṣāṃ tataḥ śṛṇutatkāle mṛtarūpaṃ tu śivalokaṃ sa gacchatisparśadīkṣāvidhiṃ proktaṃ vācakaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇuyasyākṣarasvarūpaṃ tu dīkṣā dhyānakramaṃ kramātagnikāryeti sarvaṃ ca manasā kalpayecchubhammama dattamidaṃ sarvaṃ kāmaṃ mama vanaṃ vidhiḥdīkṣāmārgakramaṃ proktaṃ utsavaṃ vakṣyate śṛṇudīkṣite sthāpane caiva snapane prokṣaṇe tathākarṣaṇe pratimākāre śilāsaṅgrahaṇe tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abhiṣekadinātpūrve navame saptame'thavāpālikā ghaṭikā caiva śarāvaṃ ca tridhā bhavetpālikāṣṭadaśāṃgulyamuccamātrāṅgulena tutadardhaṃ pādavistāraṃ tat ṣaḍbhāgaikamoṣṭakamvistārasya tribhāgaikaṃ varttitaṃ bilamucyatevistāra sa tribhāgaikaṃ daṇḍavistāramucyateghaṭikā ghaṭavistāra manvaṅgla suvistarampañcavaktra samāyuktaṃ ghaṭikāṃ kārayet tataḥpādavistāramardhaṃ tu utsedhaṃ bilasaṃyutambhinnaṃ ca suṣiraṃ kālaṃ bhedakoṇaṃ ca nīlakamśūlī mukundadhārāśca pālikā"ṣcādhidevatāḥprāsāda pūrve aiśānye dakṣiṇe uttare tathāmadhye vyomapadaṃ grāhya lepayedabhineṣṭakṛtsthaṇḍilaṃ kārayeddhīmān aṣṭadroṇaistuśālibhiḥsthāpayet karṇikāmadhye candrakumbhamalaṅkṛtampūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ dhyānamārgeṇa pūjayetpāyasānnaṃ dadet paścāt tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayetvinyasedguṭikā dvau tu koṇeṣu ca padadvayoḥkuśāgreścaiva darbhaiśca nicchidraṃ suṣiraṃ kurutato menyastu tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tu viśeṣataḥtilasarṣapamudgaṃ ca māṣaṃ śimbaṃ tu bṛṃhiṇāācāryo vāpayedbījān prāṅmukhodaṅmukhopi vāācāryaṃ pūjayet tatra vastrahemāṅgulīyakaiḥuttamaṃ tu navāṃbhasyāt saptamaṃ madhyameva catriyahaṃ caivamekāhaṃ ācāryo svecchayādine
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: utsavārambha pūrve tu kuṇḍalakṣaṇa mucyatehomakuṇḍadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ tādṛśaṃ mekhalānvitamutsedhaṃ tu navāṅgulyaṃ vistārasya pramāṇataḥtrimekhalāṅgulaṃ vakṣye viśeṣeṇa maheśvaraaparācchaivadvyaṅgulyaṃ vistārotsedhameva caekāṅgulaṃ tadutsedhaṃ vistāraṃ caturaṅgulamkṛttikādyādi māse tu kṛttike kṛttikāntakammāghamāse tu māghāntaṃ phālgune cottarāntakamjyeṣṭhamāse tu mūlāntaṃ utsavānte dine śubhepūrvabhādre mahāmāse sa puṣyabhādrāntamucyatesarvamāseṣu kartavyaṃ ādrābhaṃ syāt śivotsavamdinānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ caṇḍasya lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuprāsādānta samaṃ daṇḍaṃ prāsāda śirasāntakamukṣasthalāntaṃ kūṭāntaṃ gopurāntaṃ tathaiva cakarṇanābhisu madhye vā bhūtamālāmathāpi vātrihastena vimānena dviguṇaṃ daṇḍamucyatepañcahastaṃ tadūrdhve tu madhyamādi ca daṇḍakamcandanaṃ caiva dāruṃ ca bilvaṃ campakameva cakundapunnāgakhadiraṃ arjunaṃ ketakī tathācaturviṃśāṅgulaṃ nāhaṃ madhyamaṃ tu vidhīyatecaturviṃśāṅgulaṃ nāhaṃ agrametatprakīrtitamuttamaṃ madhyamaṃ caiva tvadhamaṃ nāhamucyateuttamaṃ hastamātraṃ tu phalakāpañcasaṃyutamaṣṭādaśāṅgulāyāmaṃ daśāṅgula suvistṛtamhastamātra pramāṇena vistāraṃ caturaṅgulam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00424 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptabhāgaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā * * * * * (?) kalpayetmadhyamaṃ aptahastaṃ ca tvadhaṃ ṣaḍahastakampañcatālottama * * * * * * * * * * (?)trikoṇamāyataṃ kṛtvā pucchadvayasama**(?)pucchaṃ ca vistārārdhaṃ vā dvipucchaṃ vā tripucchakamvṛṣabhasyottare bhāge gomayālepite śubhetasyopari padanyasya vilikhedvṛṣabhādikamchatraṃ dīpadvayaṃ caiva pārśvayoścāmare tathāśvetaṃ vṛṣabharūpaṃ tu śṛṅge rakte prakīrtitamasitaṃ vāsitaṃ vāpi śubhamālekhayedvṛṣamnavadhvajasamāyuktaṃ aindrakūṭagajākṛtiḥsiṃhaṃ naiṛtadeśe tu makaraṃ vāruṇe tathāaiśānyāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ caiva metaddakṣiṇapārśvakeviśeṣāt pañcagavyena mūladevārcanaṃ śubhamyathāvibhavavistāraṃ arcayeddeśikottamaḥdvihastasya tu vistāraṃ śālibhiścaturaṅgulamadakena tilaiḥ paścāt catuṣkoṇādi lekhayetkūrcoparinyaset kumbhaṃ varṇaṃ rājata tāmrakamsauvarṇenātha raupyeṇa kārpāsa vihitena vāgandhodakena saṃpūrṇaṃ pañcaratnasamanvitametāni pañcaratnāni vṛṣakumbhe vinikṣipetvastreṇa veṣṭayitvā ca gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ pradāpayetdhvajaṃ dakṣiṇatonyasya dhvajayaṣṭi tathottaramśanaiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā ālayaṃ tu samāśrayetdhvajasthānakramaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣvevaṃ maheśvara

sanskrit: dvihastaṃ vā trihastaṃ vā hastamānamathāpi vātatra mūrtiṃ tu daṇḍena sthāpayet tatra daṇḍakamtadutsedhaṃ tritālasyāṃ mekhaloparivinyasetutsedhasya tu vistāraṃ tadardhaṃ vā viśeṣataḥitthaṃ vilakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt uttamottama vedikāmvṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā padmākāraṃ prakalpayetbhasmarekhā trayopetaṃ śvetapuṣpairalaṅkṛtamdhvaja aṣṭacāgraṃ saṃyuktaṃ ghaṇṭāmālāvibhūṣitamdaśākṣareṇa mantreṇa rajjubandhaṃ krameṇa tusvaramādyādibījena pūjayet tatra vāhanamālayantu tathā grāmaṃ nagaraṃ pattanaṃ ca vaidhvajasthānaṃ samāśritya yaṣṭasthāpanasaṃyutamprāsādābhimukhaṃ kuryāt dhvajānāṃ tu nibandhanamsarvalakṣaṇa saṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamśuklamālā guṇopete śuklayajñopavītalamprokṣayedastramantreṇa pūjayitvā yathākramamtadannaṃ japaputrārthaṃ bhogarthaṃ ca maheśvaravastreṇa veṣṭayeddaṇḍaṃ darmaissāgraiśca sundaraiḥtrisandhyāṃ pūjayet paścāt pāyasaṃ dadetmahākālaṃ tu caṇḍeśo vedikādiṣu pūjayetphālakā pañcadaivatyaṃ suṣiraṃ pārvatīmayamvṛṣabhastvīśa daivatyaṃ śūlo jyotsnādhi daivatamcāmare candrasūryeśe ghaṇṭāvṛṣabhadaivatādikṣvaṣṭāsu ca saṃsthāpya dhvanān saṃpūjayet sudhīḥarcayet sarvadevāṃśca gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt

sanskrit: maṇḍapasyāgrataḥ kuryāt maṇḍalaṃ caturaśrakamdalaiṣvaṣṭasya saṃpūjya navaśaktiṃ yathākramammūlamantraṃ samuccārya praṇavena ca saṃyutambherikā skandadaivatyā sparśanī vāyudevatācarmasūtraṃ vāsukīśaṃ valayau candrabhāskarauarcayitvā sugandhādyaiḥ hṛdayena vicakṣaṇaḥtatpūruṣeti mantreṇa vādyakānāṃ tu tāḍayetvṛṣatālaṃ śūlatālaṃ kaṭatālaṃ vitālakamgrāmasīmni balaṃ caiva brahmādīśānameva caetaidravyairbaliṃ kuryāt devānāṃ ca svanāmataḥāvāhanādi tīrthāntaṃ trisandhyāṃ tatra pūjayetutsavatīrthamuddiśyāpyaṅgaṃ pratyaṅgasāntakamdhvajadaṇḍādikaṃ vṛkṣaṃ baliṃ sarvapratiṣṭhitamyatra ḍokārathāṃ caiva yantraṃ raṅgāstathaiva cayantravṛkṣā yantranaṭā yantragopturakāṇi cavṛṣayantrā bhūtayantrā devayantrāstathaiva cachatrāṇi nānārūpāṇi cāmarāṇi ca kārayetālayasyaiśa digbhāge prapāṃ kṛtvāti sundarāmyāgaśālāṃ tataḥ kuryāt aiśānye pāvake'thavādaśahastaṃ navahastaṃ saptahastamathāpi vādarbhamālā samāyuktaṃ vitāna dhvajaśobhitamhastamātrocchritaṃ saumyaṃ darpaṇodarasannibhamṣaḍbhidroṇaiḥ pañcabhirvā catudroṇairyathāvidhiutsavasyāti rātre tu dakṣiṇeśaṃ mahārcanamvidadhyādutsavāraṃbhe pūrvavaccāṅkurārpaṇam

sanskrit: sahasrakalaśaṃ sthāpya saṃprokṣaṇa mathācaretmūlaliṅgamadṛśyaṃ ca navaliṅgaṃ tu pūjayethṛnmantreṇa śataṃ japtvā paṃcagavyena prokṣaṇampramādāccalite liṅge sthāpayet pūrvavacchubhampūrvameva kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ tasyaprākāraliṅgakamkhaṇḍastuṇḍamiti proktaṃ na cotpāṭana doṣakamvarṇamantraṃ śataṃ hutvā śikhamantraṃ śataṃ japettasmāt sarvaprayatnena na pārśvasthaṃ liṅgapūrvakamrājarāṣṭrabhayaṃ duḥkhaṃ rājānaṃ tu vardhanamdusthitaṃ susthitaṃ vā'pi śivaliṅgaṃ na cālayetanyaliṅgasya calanaṃ rājarāṣṭrābhivṛddhidambhaktānāṃ parivārāṇāṃ vastrādīni pradāpayetliṅge vivarṇaṃ saṃprāpte pratimārodane'pi vāapāmārga samidbhiśca varṇamantraṃ śataṃ japetpratimārodane caiva tatpūrve homamācaretśaṃcame iti mantreṇa ekāhotsavamācaretprāsāde patite bhinne caitya vṛkṣaphalīkṛteevamādau samutpanne rājā rāṣṭrabhayaṃ bhavetaśvattha samidhā caiva varṇamantraṃ śataṃ hunetbhūmikampe diśāṃ dāhe pratibhāskaradarśanepuścamatsyasamāyoge janānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavetgurustryambakamantreṇa ayutaṃ homamācaretmāsapūrṇaṃ kramācchānti kuryāddoṣa nivṛttayeratnakānyāyamutpanne prāsāde madhusaṃśritetatpradeśādbahirnītvā pūrayecchuddhapāṃsubhiḥ

sanskrit: devasyāgrata aiśānye maṇṭapaṃ kalpayecchubhamsaptāhaṃ vā tryāhaṃ vā trisandhyaṃ homamācaretsarvadoṣapraśamanaṃ śivamantraṃ śataṃ hunetśītakumbhaṃ ca vidhinā śirasordhvani dāpayetpañcagavyābhiṣekaṃ ca kuryāt pūrvoktavartmanādarpaṇaṃ calitaṃ vāpi jīrṇaṃ vā patitaṃ tu vāsthāpayedvarṇamantreṇa gṛhītvā darpaṇaṃ navampūrvādikṣu caturdikṣu caturvedairniṣevitaḥpañcagavyena siddhena tathā pañcāmṛtena caharidrāmalakādyaiśca śuddhānnaṃ cābhiṣecayetprabhūta haviṣaṃ datvā tadante dviguṇaṃ smṛtamyatra śāntikṛtā tatra dhanadhānyaṃ ca vardhaterājarāṣṭrābhivṛdhyarthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ mayoditamsamuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śivaloke mahīyatetat kleśaṃ tu kṛtārthāya sayāti paramāṃ gatimutsave balikāle tu yaḥ kuryāt tu pradakṣiṇamsthalepuṣpaṃ jalepuṣpaṃ puṣpapādyasyamodatesa eva dhanavān śrīmān ihaloke supūjitaḥmama pādajale snātvā tatphalaṃ samavāpnuyātsnāpayeddevadeveśaṃ gavāṃ koṭiphalaṃ bhavetnānābhoga samopetā śivaloke mahīyatevastramābharaṇādīni yo dadyāt tu viśeṣataḥpūjyavānihalokeṣu śaivaṃ padamavāpnuyātgrāmāṇāmantapaḥ sopi vṛddhivyāmekarāḍbhavetihaloke dīpavaddivyaḥ sārūpyaṃ ca sa gacchati

sanskrit: lavaṅgaṃ rajanīcūrṇaṃ kṣāmārjānantunāntakamrasapūrṇaṃ tathā cānyaṃ toye pūrvaṃ tu kārayetpūjyāntaṃ navakalaśaṃ pañcaviṃśadguṇāntakamdvātriṃśatprasthasaṃyuktaṃ navaṃ vā ṣoḍaśaṃ tu vāpañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ sakūrcaṃ svastiveṣṭitamkūrcayantra samāyuktaṃ vardhanīṃ hemasaṃyutamgandhapuṣpādinārādhya varṇamantraṃ samuccaranmadhyādi mārjanāntasya yogyatantre tu pūjayetsvanāmādīn samuccārya gandhapuṣpādinārcayetpūrvoktāni ca dravyāṇi sthāpanaṃ pūrvavat kṛtamayamaṃ rādhyavaktaṃ māni samantrakamṣoḍaśa dviśataṃ proktaṃ uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ śṛṇusthāpayannī ca dravyāṇi kiñcidbhedaṃ maheśvarapañcatāla pramāṇena pādavistāra vismṛtamcatvārī vidhayaḥ prokto catvārīśca catuṣpadāmadhye navapadaṃ kṛtvā sthapayet pūrvavat kramātprathame caiva tu bījāni lohādyaiva dvitīyakampañcagavyāni triṃśadaṣṭaśataṃśubhamśvetaśālī mahāśālī raktaśālī tathaiva cadvātriṃśatkalaśaiḥ kuryāt prathamāvaraṇe nyasetcatvāriṃśacca catvāri kalaśādīn prapūjayetprathamāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇujāmbūnadaṃ ca saptaṃ ca jāti taptā ca miśritamdhāpatsaṅkhyā bhavettāni kalaśeṣvantarodakamdvitīyāvaraṇaṃ dhyātvā varṇamantreṇadeśikaḥ
